subject: Fix issues for older versions of Darwin and improve PowerPC support (#436)
reason: The change is entirely platform-conditional build/portability code for older Darwin and Apple PowerPC: macro-name fixes in src/config.h (MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED spelling, BYTE_ORDER for __APPLE__&&__POWERPC__) and crash-handler register access in src/debug.c behind __APPLE__/__ppc__/__arm64__ guards. On the Linux x86/ARM build the fuzzer runs, none of the modified lines are compiled, so there is no reachable runtime behaviour change to exercise; even on macOS the affected code only runs inside the fatal-signal crash reporter. No scenario can reach it.
